SUPREME AGILITY: The Stewards deferred the declaration of weighed-in as they were of the opinion that an incident had occurred near the 150 Metres which cast doubt on whether FIREFOOT should be declared the winner.  Subsequently J Orman, rider of the second placegetter, SUPREME AGILITY, lodged a protest/objection against FIREFOOT being declared the winner alleging interference near the 150 Metres.  K C Leung, rider of the third placegetter, HAPPY UNIVERSE, and Trainer K H Ting were requested to attend the hearing and on reviewing the video footage also lodged a protest/objection on behalf of the connections against FIREFOOT being declared the winner alleging interference inside the final 150 Metres.  On the evidence it was established that SUPREME AGILITY was crowded for room between HAPPY UNIVERSE and FIREFOOT near the 150 Metres and as a result raced in restricted room for some distance, making contact with HAPPY UNIVERSE which was racing to its outside.  The Stewards were of the opinion that had the interference not occurred SUPREME AGILITY would have finished in front of FIREFOOT bearing in mind the nose margin and the degree of interference suffered.  Accordingly, the protest/objection was sustained and the placings amended to read No. 5, SUPREME AGILITY, 1st; No. 8, FIREFOOT, 2nd; No. 2, HAPPY UNIVERSE, 3rd; and No. 12, BULL ATTITUDE, 4th.  In respect to the protest/objection on behalf of the third placegetter, HAPPY UNIVERSE, the Stewards could not be comfortably satisfied that the degree of interference suffered to HAPPY UNIVERSE as a result of a shift from FIREFOOT and in turn SUPREME AGILITY was sufficient to justify an alteration to the placings bearing in mind the margin between FIREFOOT and HAPPY UNIVERSE at the finish.  Therefore that protest/objection was overruled.  At a subsequent inquiry K Teetan, rider of FIREFOOT, was severely reprimanded for failing to make sufficient effort to prevent his mount from shifting out when it had a tendency to do so.  Sent for sampling post-race. J Orman was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides near the 250 Metres.
